snippet.title: GTA: Streatham hill trailer (June 2010)
snippet.description:
Another video to show tham i am still working on this game, Created with 3D Gamestudio i have recreated a real town in London. Although only 20% complete you can download the BETA at http://anthonystaines.com/games.htm
(Requires 1.5GB RAM winxp, 2GB for Vista/ 7 and 128MB VRAM)
